description: This file defines the interface ISiloStatusOracle in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which provides methods for querying and subscribing to silo status information within a distributed Orleans cluster.

classes.name: ISiloStatusOracle
classes.description: An interface for obtaining and subscribing to silo status information within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: CurrentStatus
methods.description: Property to get the current status of this silo.

methods.name: SiloName
methods.description: Property to get the name of this silo.

methods.name: SiloAddress
methods.description: Property to get the address of this silo.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an immutable array of addresses of currently active silos.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns an approximate status of a specified silo.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of silo addresses to their approximate statuses, optionally filtered to only active silos.

methods.name: TryGetSiloName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the name of a specified silo.

methods.name: IsFunctionalDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a silo is valid for directory operations.

methods.name: IsDeadSilo
methods.description: Checks if a silo is dead.

methods.name: SubscribeToSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to silo status change events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from silo status change events.
